# graphiant_enterprise (Resource)

An enterprise or MSP tenant. Credits/billing are fields on this resource (enterprise_contract, credit_limit) — the API has no standalone credits resource. Create has no response body, so the new enterprise is located afterward by matching company_name+account_type in the enterprise list — this will fail ambiguously if another enterprise with the same name and type already exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graphiant_enterprise" "customer" {
  account_type = "enterprise"
  company_name = "Acme Corp"

  admin_email      = "admin@acme.example"
  admin_first_name = "Jane"
  admin_last_name  = "Doe"

  credit_limit = 1000

  enterprise_contract = {
    contracted_credits = 500
    expiration_date = {
      month = 12
      year  = 2026
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_type` (String)
- `company_name` (String)
- `enterprise_contract` (Attributes) Billing contract; contracted_credits is where an enterprise's or MSP pool's credits are set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprise_contract))

### Optional

- `admin_email` (String)
- `admin_first_name` (String) Only used at creation; the API has no update endpoint for this field.
- `admin_last_name` (String) Only used at creation; the API has no update endpoint for this field.
- `admin_time_zone` (String) Only used at creation; the API has no update endpoint for this field.
- `cloud_provider` (String)
- `credit_limit` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `impersonation_enabled` (Boolean) Not settable at creation; only updatable afterward.
- `logo` (String)
- `marketplace_id` (String)
- `portal_banner` (String) Not settable at creation; only updatable afterward.
- `proxy_tenant_id` (Number) Not settable at creation; only updatable afterward.
- `small_logo` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graphiant_enterprise.customer <enterprise_id>
```
